aiVerification.summary: The draft cites real report rows but merges distinct process NG-rate checks, sample-type function checks, and normal comparison into one ambiguous changed-factor definition.
issues: Blocking: changedFactor incorrectly frames the evidence as one Normal-vs-all comparison, while the source appears to contain separate contexts: process vision NG-rate check and main-line function testing of NG over-bond sample types versus Normal.
Blocking: baselineCondition='Normal' is only supported for the function-check table, not for the process NG-rate table covering Vision Bond BP/SM, MG/PT, and Yoke.

Blocking: rows 26.03!30 and 26.03!31 are central to the function comparison but their row text is not included in the provided contextRows, so their interpretation cannot be independently verified here.

Non-blocking: changeDomain='material' is likely too narrow or inaccurate; this appears to be process/defect-condition validation involving over glue/over bond samples and vision/main-line function checks.
Non-blocking: analysis sheets for BP+SM and Yoke identify Glue Clots quantities but are not represented as outcomes or supporting evidence, despite being relevant to NG function analysis.
correctionPlan: Split or clearly subgroup the changed factor into the actual evidence contexts: process vision NG-rate check by process, and function check by sample condition/type versus Normal.
Use Normal only as the baseline for the function-check outcome if rows 26.03!30-32 confirm the table structure.
Add the full row text and headers for 26.03!27-32 or equivalent evidence rows so the function-check table can be verified.
Revise changedFactor wording to focus on NG over glue/over bond sample condition/location rather than listing every metric row as a changed condition.
Consider adding analysis-sheet outcomes/supporting evidence for Glue Clots: BP+SM quantity 1 and Yoke quantity 3, if these sheets are part of the same validation report.
Reassess changeDomain after regrouping; process defect/function defect context may be more appropriate than material alone.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are row-level and mostly sufficient for existence, but final evidence is not sufficient until key cited function rows and grouping headers are visible and the changed-factor grouping is corrected.
